<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="LrGhgEXnLvHTv-V_-ogK"> <mxGraphModel dx="1460" dy="806" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;dashed=1;endArrow=classic;" value="HTTP / REST API"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=classic;" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;dashed=1;endArrow=classic;" value="documents"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Employee as Corporate Employee
 participant WebApp as Next.js Web App
 participant API as Express REST API Server
 participant ORM as Prisma ORM
 participant DB as MySQL Database
 participant Notify as Notification Service
 participant Green as Green API
 participant Mail as Nodemailer

 Employee->>WebApp: Submit booking form
 WebApp->>API: POST /api/bookings with payload
 API->>ORM: Check time slot overlap
 ORM->>DB: Query bookings<br/>startTime < end AND endTime > start
 DB-->>ORM: Return overlapping bookings
 ORM-->>API: Return conflict status

 alt Conflict exists
 API-->>WebApp: HTTP 409 Conflict
 WebApp-->>Employee: Prompt to select another room
 else Slot is free
 API->>ORM: INSERT booking with status Confirmed
 ORM->>DB: INSERT into bookings table
 DB-->>ORM: Booking created
 ORM-->>API: Booking record

 API->>ORM: INSERT booking history audit log
 ORM->>DB: INSERT into booking_histories table
 DB-->>ORM: Audit log created
 ORM-->>API: Audit log confirmation

 API->>Notify: Trigger booking notifications
 par Broadcast WhatsApp alert
 Notify->>Green: broadcastWhatsAppBookingNotification
 Green-->>Notify: WhatsApp notification sent
 and Send confirmation email
 Notify->>Mail: sendBookingConfirmationEmail
 Mail-->>Notify: Confirmation email sent
 end

 API-->>WebApp: HTTP 201 Created with booking details
 WebApp-->>Employee: Display booking confirmation screen
 end",
 "config": null
